verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships official SDKs across several languages. There is a first-party JavaScript SDK repo with `Eval` usage examples, a versioned Python SDK reference (`Eval` and `Evaluator`, plus the `wrap_openai` drop-in wrapper), a Go SDK with `trace/contrib` auto-instrumentation, and a Java SDK with a JVM agent. These are backed by an API reference for managing projects, experiments, datasets, prompts and scorers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
